notes: The two articles are treated differently on rule 76's availability test: the first is displaced by the free genitive ἡμῶν, the second takes the repeated our itself, rule 103's function-word clause putting a repeated determiner on the member it introduces. Reading the second our as a discontinuous second realization of ἡμῶν under rule 15, leaving s008 unrepresented, remains defensible and is what rule 76's for me in my bonds precedent would support.
